Class AetherisNotebookPanel.TokenModel

java.lang.Object
org.aetheris.swing.AetherisNotebookPanel.TokenModel
Enclosing class:
AetherisNotebookPanel
static final class AetherisNotebookPanel.TokenModel extends Object
The class TokenModel is one model row in the token window. The field label is the text the combo box shows. The field family is the provider word, such as ollama, grok, or pool. The field window is the context window. The field windowKnown says whether that window is a positive budget. The field completionCap is the reply limit. The field completionKnown says whether that limit is positive. A caller passes the six values to the constructor. toString() returns the label for the combo box. A null label is stored as an empty string. A null family is stored as an empty string. A window flag is kept only when the window is greater than 0. A completion flag is kept only when the cap is greater than 0.

  • Constructor Details

    • TokenModel

      private TokenModel(String label, String family, int window, boolean windowKnown, int completionCap, boolean completionKnown)
      The constructor stores one model row. A null label is stored as an empty string. A null family is stored as an empty string. windowKnown is stored only when the flag is true and window is greater than 0. completionKnown is stored only when the flag is true and completionCap is greater than 0.
      Parameters:
      label - The label is the combo text, or null when the row has no name.
      family - The family is the provider word, or null when the row has no family.
      window - The window is the context window.
      windowKnown - The window-known flag is true when the caller has a real budget.
      completionCap - The completion cap is the reply limit.
      completionKnown - The completion-known flag is true when the caller has a reply limit.
